description: The autonomy.grant dry run (S56 T10, behaviour 4): the same request as grant.json with dryRun:true — every validation runs, nothing is written, and the result is the daemon's OWN sentence of what the grant would allow: the root, each action it would cover in plain words, the cap, the budget, the expiry, and the absence of the merge (the S57 rule is a separate decision, so a grant that does not cover it says so). The grant field is null — there is no row, and a dry run that carried a view would be a decision made twice.

result.confirmation: dry run: this would let an unattended loop started on aeon open a pull request, up to 5 a day, while the budget has room, until 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z — nothing was written. It does not let it merge.
